TZA.note: Mentions fees for NIDA's information sharing service but no authentication service is described.
No link with the civil register is mentioned.
Gives cards printed and distributed, not people enrolled over the population.
No number at birth is mentioned.

facts.fact: Parliament's committee visited NIDA's main centre for processing and keeping people's data, where NIDA itself printed 20,548,067 national IDs by February 2024, per Deputy Minister Jumanne Sagini.

systems.system: National ID project (NIN and national ID card)

TZA.note: No public register keyed on the NIN is mentioned.

facts.fact: Deputy Minister Sagini said NIDA had printed 20,548,067 national ID cards and distributed 19,743,367 by February 2024 for people registered and given a national identification number (NIN).

TZA.note: Iris and face verification for people without usable fingerprints is only a strategy being prepared; no certification or audit.
